detail.law: pH sets the protonation of every rate that has an acid-base step (free Mg2+ speciating the nucleotide pool was the other half of this entry and is IMPLEMENTED — SPECIATION_ROWS)
detail.blocker: a pH-dependent rate needs a rate row measured AGAINST pH, and this corpus contains none: of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH at all (pinned by tests/product/cell/test_bounded_omissions.py). Verified again on 2026-09-21 by the bundle-kind/speciation lane over spec.example.toml and the codex/bio-wiring-20260915 source branch: no pH-dependent rate law exists on either. Writing one would be inventing a law, which the lane brief forbids, so this row STOPS here. The screening half of the old entry is also still unbuildable: no relation kind carries a charge, and giving one a charge is a resolution decision (see the bound), not a missing line of code
detail.bound: E' P2 / P3, two numbers. (i) SCREENING: at chem.ionic_strength 150 mM the Debye length is 0.8 nm — 1/56 of the SHORTEST interaction reach in the spec (erm.reach 45 nm) and 1/62 of resolution.spacing, so a screened term is exp(-56) = 3.7e-25 of an unscreened one at the closest distance this model resolves. (ii) SPECIATION, kept as the PREDICTION the device run is compared with now that the law is BUILT: at chem.mg_free 500 uM and chem.mgatp_kd 100 uM (a spec row since 2026-09-21; it was literature-only when this bound was written), [MgATP] is 0.8333 x chem.atp_conc, so the ATP-binding edge runs at 2500 /s instead of 3000 /s and the crossbridge cycle time 0.486 s (sum of 1/k_adp_release, 1/k_stroke, 1/k_pi_release, 1/k_hydrolysis, 1/(k_atp_bind x atp_conc)) lengthens by 0.014 %; even at a 10x weaker Kd of 1000 uM it is 0.137 %
detail.verdict: SMALL FOR THIS ENGINE — the screened term is below floating-point at the model's own resolution, and Mg-ATP speciation (now BUILT) moves the crossbridge cycle by 0.014 % (0.14 % at a 10x weaker Kd), far inside the spread the rate rows already declare. The honesty this number does NOT buy: chem.mg_free and chem.ph are often called "the conditions the rates were measured at", and reading the sources says otherwise — of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH, and the 3 that state Mg (Pollard 1986) state 1 mM TOTAL MgCl2 at 22 C in 50 mM KCl (ionic strength ~53 mM), not 0.5 mM FREE Mg at 150 mM. So the transfer error in those rows is UNBOUNDED by anything in this file; what is bounded here is only this engine's sensitivity. Closing that needs the sources read and their conditions written into the rows (a KB item, INVENTORY E' P3)

PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

relations.title: Cortex, membrane and motor construction geometry
relations.expression: r_shell = R - a_realized^2/(6R) - erm.r0 - h/2; N_cortex = round(4*pi*r_shell^2*density); N_NMII uses the same shell area
relations.qualification: a_realized is the realized mesh edge, not simply the input target spacing. Shared geometry does not establish biological abundance covariance.

relations.title: Material quantities become geometry-dependent coefficients
relations.expression: axial = EA/chord; bend = kappa/mean(adjacent_chords); node_mass = rho*pi*r^2*sum(incident_chords)/2
relations.qualification: These are derived coefficients on realized geometry, not additional biological free parameters.

relations.title: Membrane excess area and its geometric carriers
relations.expression: f_wrinkle = max(f_total - f_tubes, 0); f_tubes = A_tubed_mesh/A_smooth_mesh - 1; f_tubes cannot exceed f_total
relations.qualification: The implemented tube area is measured from constructed geometry. A cylinder-area approximation is not the implemented exact budget.

relations.title: ERM abundance, capture and occupancy are different quantities
relations.expression: capacity = min(round(density*A_built), membrane_nodes); ideal_zero_load_fraction = k_on/(k_on+k_off0); Fchar = kBT/x_beta
relations.qualification: The fraction is the stationary two-state rate-matrix result before geometric capture and load limits. Capacity is not realized occupied links.

relations.title: Assembled motors, competent heads and cycle occupancy
relations.expression: assembled_heads = 2*heads_per_side*N_assembled; with object_life: p_assembled = ka/(ka+kd), N_total = round(N_assembled/p_assembled); built_heads = 2*heads_per_side*N_total; three-state zero-load pi proportional to (1,a/(b+c),a*c/(d*(b+c)))
relations.qualification: The stationary expression uses a=k_on, b=k_off0, c=k_stroke, d=k_adp_release. It does not apply to five/seven/eight-state cycles, geometric capture constraints or load-dependent duty. In this implementation competent_head_fraction directly validates and returns nmii.rlc_phosphorylated_fraction. Whole-object assembly and cycle occupancy remain separate. When object_life is off, N_total=N_assembled. If ka=kd=0 the implementation uses no reserve; ka=0 with kd>0 refuses.

relations.title: Motor chemistry shares temperature and nucleotide context
relations.expression: kBT = 1.380649e-5*T; Fchar = kBT/x; MgATP_fraction = Mg_free/(Kd+Mg_free); association_rate = association_coefficient*MgATP_fraction*ATP_concentration
relations.qualification: Free Mg and total ATP are distinct. Source-derived actin bending stiffness is a stored literal; changing temperature does not recompute that parameter.

relations.title: Transport speed, priming and lifetime consistency
relations.expression: walk rates = v/(spacing*f), v/(spacing*(1-f)); expected run length = v/k_off0; existing guard compares expected/stated run length
relations.qualification: One node-spacing event represents multiple molecular cycles. Molecular step-size statistics cannot be inferred from these events. The atlas does not change the guard tolerance.

relations.title: IF architecture and nuclear size share a construction rule
relations.expression: Rn = R*nc_ratio; shell = Rn+gap; historical_span = r_cortex-Rn-2*gap; r_mid = Rn+gap+historical_span/2; contour_target = 4*pi*r_mid^2*historical_span/mesh^2; rings = round(contour_target/(2*pi*shell)); EA = E*pi*r^2; kappa = E*pi*r^4/4
relations.qualification: Contour preservation from a former spoke construction is an explicit model choice. It is not a measured IF density law. Surface remapping changes realized contour.

relations.title: Nuclear links reuse parameters with distinct meanings
relations.expression: lamina vertices = round(4*pi*Rn^2/lamina.filament^2); lamina-envelope links limited by round(linc_density*A_envelope) and available nodes; chromatin crosslinks = round(0.5*crosslink_fraction*domain_count)
relations.qualification: Shared linc.k does not establish empirical equality of mechanics. linc.tension is an observer comparison row, not a stiffness input.

relations.title: Pore conductance and areal conductivity
relations.expression: G_single = pi*r^4/(8*eta*L); Lp_areal = pore_density*G_single; pore_density*pi*r^2 < 1; pore_length >= envelope.spacing
relations.qualification: Single-pore G is mislabeled with areal Lp units in the current docstring; this card reports dimensional algebra, not a runtime fix. The cylinder formula omits entrance and mesh resistance.

relations.title: Osmolarity, accessible water volume and molecule inventory
relations.expression: Vwater_cyt = f_cyt*(Vmem-Vnuc); Vwater_nuc = f_nuc*Vnuc; molecules = c_mM*Vwater*602214.076; pressure_per_mM is checked against R*T_reference
relations.qualification: Conditional on water_permeation. Fixed impermeant solute counts do not model arbitrary small-solute equilibration. Surface pressure/volume penalties and double-sheet cases have explicit refusals.

relations.title: Reference Reynolds number is a build diagnostic
relations.expression: Uref = stroke*k_stroke; Re_ref = 1e-9*rho*Uref*dx/eta
relations.qualification: Reference motor speed and Reynolds number are derived diagnostics, not measured run speed or hydrodynamic validation.

ISOFORM ERROR CORRECTED: the former 0.35/s is NMIIB's unloaded ADP release (Kovacs 2007 Table 1: NM2B single-headed 0.38 +/- 0.09, HMM 0.27 +/- 0.06; Wang 2003). NMIIA — the engine's motor (hand_kmc.NMIIA_MYOSIN; x_adp derived for 2A) — is k0 = 2.7 +/- 0.3/s (single-headed, = Kovacs 2003 JBC 278:38132, 10.1074/jbc.M305453200, SE550 OK) / 2.9 +/- 1.0 (HMM); Stam 2015 carries 1.71/s from Kovacs 2003 -> spread: 1.7-2.9/s (lognormal prior, factor 1.3). Kovacs 2007 PNAS 104:9994 (doi 10.1073/pnas.0701181104, PMID 17548820, SE424 OK): resisting load slows it 5x (2A: 2.9 -> 0.59) / 12x (2B), assisting load speeds it 4x (11/s) — the load factors and x_adp were already 2A's, only the base rate was 2B's. Formerly: resisting load slows it 5x (2A) / 12x (2B) at ~2 pN, assisting load speeds it 4x. READ by bonds._crossbridge as the stroked state's detachment (2026-09-06, KB-2026-09-06 §4.8/§7.1b: unbound from the SWEPT k_off0). KB: SE424 Kovacs2007_PNAS, source_audit OK 2026-09-06 12:0x (key repaired from the encoding-stripped Kovcs2007; audit re-run). actin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fraction.name: actin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of built filament subunits carrying cofilin. THIS ROW STANDS IN FOR BINDING KINETICS THAT ARE NOT WIRED: no cofilin binding row exists in this file (nor on codex/bio-wiring-20260915, whose cofilin path is a 64-row molecular G/F preparation that is not ported), so the decoration cannot be computed from the file and is DECLARED. Sized from stoichiometry and from what cofilin does in a resting cell, not from any gate: one cofilin per actin protomer against actin_chem.cofilin_conc 20 uM and the filament this spec builds puts the hard ceiling at 0.0987 on the shipped build (1.021e7 molecules against 1.035e8 built protomers; cell/severing.decorated_fraction_ceiling recomputes it from the BUILT protomer count and refuses anything above it, with both counts in the message); and most cofilin in a resting cell is Ser3-phosphorylated and cannot bind F-actin at all, so the resting decoration sits well under that ceiling. 0.05 is an order-of-magnitude EXAMPLE inside it and a PI-GAP inference target, not a measurement. WARNING the real law (Kadzik 2026, aleph/laws/cofilin_severing.py) severs at decorated/bare BOUNDARIES and peaks at INTERMEDIATE decoration, while the uniform-rate form this row feeds is monotone in it — no run may claim the occupancy dependence. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

arp23.nucleation_reserve_fraction.name: arp23.nucleation_reserve_fraction

declaration.source: SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). crosslink.k.name: crosslink.k

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

crosslink.molecular_model.name: crosslink.molecular_model

declaration.source: WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

envelope.mu_2d.name: envelope.mu_2d

declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

membrane.inplane_friction.name: membrane.inplane_friction

declaration.source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

raw_declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

raw_declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: Current point is NMIIA 2.7/s. Stored spread 0.34 and its text remain tied to former NMIIB ~0.35/s and a factor-of-1.4 heuristic. The corrected spec source also retains that obsolete trailing sentence.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Adjudicate the intended NMIIA uncertainty quantity and provenance, then reconcile the three conflicting source narratives. Do not automatically turn the historical 1.7–2.9 cross-carrier span into an SD.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Primary Table 1 reports NM2A single-headed 2.7±0.3/s and HMM 2.9±1.0/s; construct difference and SEM are distinct from the stored heuristic.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: Kovacs 2007 Table 1 labels values as means ± SEM, with n between 3 and 9. The NMIIB single-headed row displays 0.38±0.09/s; it is carried from Wang 2003.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Decide whether the prior represents uncertainty in a condition-specific mean, biological variation, transfer uncertainty or model discrepancy, and obtain the specific sample count before any conversion.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Current 0.22 is ln(1.24) rounded, not a reported log-space SD. Individual n is not assigned in the table. Stopped-flow methods use 25°C; target is 310 K.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: IIA width 0.15 records mismatch between resisting and assisting derived lengths. IIB inherits that IIA discrepancy. Neither is a measured SD for the target Bell length.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Document assumed load and directional model approximation separately from statistical uncertainty; require an explicit reason before transferring the width across isoforms.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Primary rate ratios support the derivation input, but Table 2 derives mechanical loads with smooth-muscle mechanical parameters. The project uses x=kBT ln(rate ratio)/assumed load, not an independently measured NMII force-length distribution.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: Moore 2019 contains MCF7 IFC diameter ratio 0.68±0.08. Results report n=2164, Table 1 n=2004; SASAM n=37 belongs to this 2019 paper, not the cited 2016 DOI.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Resolve the exact dataset and uncertainty definition, keep radius/diameter ratio distinct from area or volume ratios, and adjudicate support within (0,1).
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Discussion describes population dispersion as standard deviation; Table 1 does not itself label the ± convention. Treat as SD-context with incomplete explicit table labeling, never SEM by assumption. Registered 2016 identity does not validate the unregistered 2019 source.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: Kojima 1994 abstract reports 43.7±4.6 pN/nm without tropomyosin for a 1 um filament. EA scales this by length and rounds the central value.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Locate primary uncertainty definition and n before interpreting relative dispersion as a distribution; distinguish specimen variation, estimator error and transfer.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: The accessible abstract does not resolve SD versus SEM. Current b/a≈0.1053 is a linear relative-dispersion mapping to sigma_ln. Rounding and median-versus-mean convention are separate from source uncertainty.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: The parser selects 2.5e2–7.5e2 pN/um from a lamin-attributable whole-nucleus response estimate. Both the spec and project source explicitly deny a measurement of isolated double-bilayer+NPC shear with lamina separate.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Retain response-level evidence and explicit component/geometry derivation. PI must define the intended independent envelope quantity before adjudicating any band. Do not derive statistical uncertainty merely from matching units.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Stephens short/long-extension behavior is an assay response across cells/conditions, not an isolated shear-modulus CI. Dahl is a different species/preparation and whole-envelope quantity; no covariance or residual modulus is inferred.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: The two-decade band is explicit exploration around a point with a per-WAVE/NPF versus per-free-Arp2/3 mapping issue.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Use example_review P07 as the existing primary card and adjudicate activation fraction and attribution. Widening a scalar prior cannot repair a changed denominator.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Li/Bieling 2022 primary number is a per-NPF rate; candidate remains ineligible in saved KB. This card adds uncertainty interpretation only, not a second independent source claim.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: Project text combines a thermal model condition and a timestep-specific kick condition, then stores an exploration interval. The cited 3500 bound, point 4600 and upper endpoint 10000 are not an exact common feasible set under the text as written.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: PI should clarify which conditional derivation is operative and whether this interval describes exploration or admissibility. Do not relabel a bond-well curvature as intact-linker compliance.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Bounds depend on temperature, Bell length and timestep; they are not an experimental confidence interval. No numeric replacement or mechanistic change is proposed.

uncertainty_review_cards.summary: Pore radius and length bands are exploration declarations. The reviewed effective diffusion geometry is not itself a hydraulic-radius uncertainty, and pore length must not be shorter than envelope spacing.
uncertainty_review_cards.PI_proposal: Define geometric, solute-accessible and hydraulic quantities separately; record the joint feasibility condition before a future design, without inventing covariance.
uncertainty_review_cards.uncertainty_detail: Source source-text bands and radius-to-fourth-power conductance dependence create derivation sensitivity, not evidence of probability or parameter independence. Existing example_review P16 is the comparator.

template_reserve_declaration.source: SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

transforms.name: Soluble concentration to integer count
transforms.units: c:uM; Vg:um^3; u:uM per monomer/unit; N:count
qualifications: No fluid.cytosol_water_fraction multiplier in this route.
For buffers and CP, count unit means represented protein equivalents.
Count rounding is half-up here, unlike Python round used for motor object counts.

transforms.name: Finite soluble buffer partition
transforms.formula: T=Gtotal-Gfree; solve sum_i B_i*a/(Kd_i+a)=T; bound_i=B_i*a/(Kd_i+a). Round total/free and buffer counts first; bound_total=Ntotal-Nfree; PFN bound count is clamped to [max(0,bound_total-NT), min(bound_total,NP)]; thymosin bound is the remainder.
transforms.units: All concentration terms and auxiliary a:uM; integer inventories:counts
qualifications: Requires 0<=Gfree<=Gtotal and total-free<=sum B.
a is an auxiliary allocation activity, explicitly not imposed Gfree or an equilibrium assertion.
Initial soluble actin species are ATP-labelled; existing polymer is separate.

transforms.name: Available capper before and after end preparation
qualifications: Conditional finite chemistry path.
Legacy retired route k_cap_on*c_CP is not a finite inventory and refuses normal use by default.

transforms.name: Cofilin capacity versus cut coefficient
transforms.formula: N_cofilin=c_cofilin*602.214*Vg*f_water; P_served=sum(rest_contour_f/delta_f over reserve-served families); decoration_ceiling=N_cofilin/P_served; cut_coefficient=severing_rate*decorated_fraction.
transforms.units: N/P:counts; decoration_ceiling:dimensionless; cut coefficient:1/(um*s) as declared by the inspected function
qualifications: Ceiling is infinity if no protomers; decorated fraction separately constrained to [0,1].
The ceiling arithmetic does not round N into a dynamically consumed protein pool.
No binding isotherm or concentration-to-occupancy inference is established.

transforms.name: Cortical Arp2/3 pool
transforms.formula: r=R-sagitta-erm.r0-h/2; sagitta=a_mesh^2/(6R); Vs=4*pi*r^2*h; Vsw=f_water*Vs; Vw=f_water*Vg; u_bath=1/(602.214076*Vw); N_Arp=floor(c_Arp*602.214076*Vsw+0.5); activity_Arp=Vw/Vsw; c_realized=N_Arp*u_bath*activity_Arp.
transforms.units: R,r,h:um; volume:um^3; c:uM; N:intact-complex count; activity:dimensionless
qualifications: Thin-shell nominal geometry, not an exact wrinkled-shell integral.
For positive site count, per-site coefficient=k_b0*602.214076*Vsw/n_sites; total propensity=k_b0*N_free*n_free_sites/n_sites.
This makes the per-complex versus per-NPF source mismatch visible; no conversion is invented.

transforms.name: Assembled versus allocated NMII objects
transforms.formula: Na=int(round(rho*4*pi*r^2)); if object_life off: Ntot=Na; else ratio=kd/ka if ka>0 else 0; pa=1/(1+ratio); Ntot=int(round(Na/pa)); Ndormant=Ntot-Na.
qualifications: Finite nonnegative rates required; ka=0,kd>0 refused; ka=kd=0 yields ratio0 and pa1 in build arithmetic.
For ka+kd>0, pa=ka/(ka+kd); exact two-state transition uses exp(-(ka+kd)*dt).
Python round supplies ties-to-even integer rounding; these are template-derived counts, not observed abundance.

transforms.name: Structural versus competent motor heads
transforms.formula: N_heads=2*H*Ntot; per isoform owner range j: N_comp_j=int(round(f_RLC*2*H*N_j)); selected owner IDs drawn uniformly without replacement.
transforms.units: H:head nodes per pole; N_heads and N_comp:head counts
qualifications: Includes allocated dormant objects. Active competent heads require intersection with alive-object mask; actin-bound/force-bearing heads require further state observations.
Metadata n_heads_competent=int(round(f_RLC*N_heads)) need not equal the sum of separately rounded isoform selections.
A structural two-headed-molecule conversion is an extra model/measurement assumption.

transforms.name: Allocated isoform share versus initial live share
transforms.formula: NA=int(round(f_A*Ntot)); NB=Ntot-NA; IIA labels original indices i<NA; initially alive iff i<Na. Therefore NA_alive=min(NA,Na); NB_alive=max(0,Na-NA); fA_alive=min(NA,Na)/Na for Na>0.
qualifications: Exact integer consequence of the inspected prefix logic, not an empirical relation.

For ka=kd>0 with life enabled, Ntot=2Na; condition f_A=0.5 implies NA=Na and all initially live objects are IIA despite 50% total allocation. This is symbolic bookkeeping, not a simulated specimen or parameter recommendation.
When f_A=1, all allocated/live objects are IIA. No IIC or mixed-object heavy-chain mapping exists here.

transforms.name: Linear nuclear ratio and reference sphere
transforms.formula: R_from_volume=(3V/(4*pi))^(1/3); Rn=q*R. Only under matching concentric spheres: Vn/Vcell=q^3 and Vn/Vcytoplasm=q^3/(1-q^3).
qualifications: Actual pool conversion reads built surface volume0.
The radius-from-volume relation is the declared source transformation, not a newly inspected primary assay.
Cohort means and nonlinear transformations cannot be freely interchanged.

transforms.name: Cytoplasmic polymer census and contour
transforms.formula: rin=q*R+gap; rout=r-h/2-gap; Vband=(4*pi/3)*(rout^3-rin^3); Lrequested=c_F*602.214/370*Vband; Nfil=int(round(Lrequested/contour)); nseg=int(round(contour/seg)); arc_step=contour/nseg.
transforms.units: c_F:uM monomer equivalents; Vband:um^3; L/contour/seg:um; 370:subunits/um; Nfil:filaments
qualifications: Geometric annulus concentration convention, no water multiplier in this census.
Need rout>rin and at least one filament; at least 3 nodes per arc.
Chord-summed/mapped/prepared rest lengths may differ from nominal contour; optional whole-rise preparation rounds realized rest length to monomer_rise units.
Polymer inventory is independent of declared soluble Gtotal and is not silently subtracted from it.

buffer_partition.meaning: Auxiliary competitive-binding activity conserves separately imposed total/free; not an equilibrium claim.

end_binding.meaning: End preparation can debit free regulator counts after soluble-pool initialization.

retired_cp.meaning: Retired two-state path refuses normal use; its concentration-times-association coefficient is a distinct historical route.

cofilin_ceiling.meaning: Concentration supports a one-cofilin-per-protomer decoration ceiling, not an occupancy fit.

cofilin_coefficient.meaning: Only reserve-served growing families enter the denominator; concentration checks capacity while rate times decorated fraction sets coefficient.

cofilin_protomers.meaning: Built rest contours, live end slots and family-specific rises produce the supplied protomer count.

shell.meaning: Nominal mid-shell radius, mesh sagitta correction and thin-shell geometric volume.

bath_geometry.meaning: Relation bath uses cytosol water volume and cortical-shell water volume.

arp_bath.meaning: Initial free complex count and volume-ratio activity reconstruct the cortical concentration.

arp_inventory.meaning: Each branch junction reserves one complex, returned by debranching.

arp_rate.meaning: Per-free-complex world propensity, site coefficient and finite free-site qualification.

arp_switch.meaning: Sites require all three rows and a positive reserve fraction.

arp_constant.meaning: 602.214076 concentration-to-count constant in the relation bath.

motor_count.meaning: Smooth mid-shell area sets assembled objects; life arithmetic creates total allocated objects; split uses that total.

motor_initial_state.meaning: Isoform and initial alive classifications both use prefixes of allocated object indices.

motor_heads.meaning: Two H-head poles per allocated object; head nodes are distinct from backbone nodes and arm subdivisions.

motor_ranges.meaning: Isoform owner ranges, total head and dormant counts, life rates and aggregate competent-head metadata.

motor_competence.meaning: Input is a validated fraction of heads competent to enter the cycle.

motor_reservoir.meaning: kd/ka reservoir arithmetic; zero and nonfinite-rate boundaries. Older reservoir-only prose precedes the later object-life implementation.

motor_population.meaning: Object-life switch; assembled/total arithmetic and conflicting assembled-fraction source-text refusal.

motor_split.meaning: Round(f times total objects), with IIB as the remainder; no IIC or mixed-head composition assignment.

motor_owners.meaning: Competence sampled and rounded per isoform owner range, including allocated dormant heads; this is not a bound-head census.

object_life_definition.meaning: Per-whole-object present/parked transitions and exact two-state probabilities, inspected as text only.

nuclear_radius.meaning: Linear nucleus-to-cell radius ratio, not area or volume ratio.

membrane_geometry.meaning: Radius drives membrane surface construction; area and volume references depend on geometric options.

under_membrane.meaning: Wrinkled membrane and envelope maps move constructed coordinates.

cytoplasmic_arcs.meaning: Geometric annulus, polymer concentration-to-length-to-filament census, then mapped arcs.

arc_discretization.meaning: Arc contour sets angular span; round(contour/seg) sets node intervals.

quantization.meaning: Optional explicit preparation changes rest lengths to integer monomer rises; does not change declared input or node positions.

limitations: Source semantic definitions here describe the unchanged declaration wording and the quantity mapping needed by code; primary-source numerical/assay adjudication belongs to the independent evidence packets.

Only enumerated source files and shown spans were read. Literal .get/.get_int/.entry extraction is bounded; f-strings, aliases, helper arguments, external drivers and archived driver copies are not an exhaustive call-path analysis.
Geometry, pool and object constructors were inspected as text only. No build, physics, prior or parameter runtime was imported or executed.
No claim is made about current live-root semantics, driver overrides, archived effective values or native observables. Cross-revision and run-context packets are separate.
Candidate reference identities were not created or repaired; unresolved declaration references are left unresolved.
No source upgrade, mechanistic decision, parameter/prior change or automatic cross-version equality is proposed.

actin_pool.scope: Bounded primary-source and quantity-definition audit of seven existing EXAMPLE concentration inputs. No parameter, prior, tag, gate or runtime change.

provenance.method: Read frozen metadata and static source; primary full-text/abstract research; stdlib validation only. No cell/runtime imports or native simulations.
provenance.source_identity_match: Normalized exact DOI against frozen source_evidence, retaining all UIDs and original audit rows. Unregistered/failed identities remain ineligible even if primary text was read.

strongest_findings: MCF7 Kiuchi2011 100/10/200 µM are model assumptions; derived fractions are one conditional fit.
Funk2019 calibrated total actin/profilin requires an assumed half-cell accessible-volume denominator.
Packed-cell Arp2 and Arp3 subunit concentrations do not establish free cortical-shell Arp2/3 complexes.
Generic BNID and Pollard review reuse is a provenance trail, not independent primary evidence.
Code uses three different denominator conventions; the optional finite-buffer path is guarded off by frozen template switch0, while free G-actin also has a base-growth read.

measured_context.cell: Acanthamoeba; Dictyostelium; unactivated neutrophils and platelets; Xenopus egg extract; yeast
measured_context.assay: Review aggregation including personal communications; not one joint experiment
measured_context.denominator: Column-specific cellular/extract concentration; primary definitions differ

findings: Table 1 Acanthamoeba: G-actin 100, profilin 100, ADF/cofilin 20, Arp2/3 2–4, capping protein 1 µM.
Table 1 unactivated platelets: G-actin 220, thymosin-β4 550, ADF/cofilin 30, Arp2/3 9, capping protein 5 µM.
Table 1 unactivated neutrophils: G-actin 300, Arp2/3 10, capping protein 1–2 µM; Xenopus extract G-actin 12, profilin 5 and thymosin-β4 20 µM.
The inspected table does not establish universal profilin 20–100, thymosin 100–500, cofilin 10–40 or Arp2/3 1–2 µM uncertainty bands.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Ranges are table summaries, not SD/SEM/CI or a covariance matrix.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: A table across cell types cannot be promoted to one matched MCF7 parameter vector. Citation columns bundle several studies; not every cell has a one-to-one primary locator.
primary_cards.upstream_trace: Acanthamoeba table refs include Gordon1976 (G/F source not resolved here), Tseng1984, Cooper1986 and Kelleher1995; platelet column includes Hartwig personal communication. Repeated reuse is not independent support.

primary_cards.anchor: Results: Estimation of cellular concentrations; Fig. 3; Methods: Model fitting of s-FDAP data

measured_context.state: Serum-starved, unstimulated baseline for jasplakinolide model; NRG experiments are separate
measured_context.assay: Dronpa-actin sequential fluorescence decay after photoactivation, jasplakinolide perturbation; relative mobile-actin signal
measured_context.denominator: Model concentrations, not independently calibrated endogenous protein per measured aqueous volume

findings: G-actin total 100, profilin total 10 and thymosin-β4 total 200 µM are assumed inputs traced to Mogilner2002, not absolute measurements by this study.
Conditional model outputs: free G-actin 1.98, profilin-bound actin 9.52, thymosin-bound actin 88.5 µM; free profilin 0.48 and thymosin 111.5 µM.
Best-fit free barbed ends 4.8 nM and jasplakinolide Kd 120 nM; inferred pointed ends about 5.52 nM. Initial G-actin components sum to the imposed 100 µM.
Fig. 1 mobile Dronpa-actin fraction 79% is not the fraction of chemically free ATP-actin.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Fig. 3 time-course means±SEM, 13–21 cells across at least three experiments; confidence intervals on inferred concentrations not located. Time-curve SEM is not a concentration prior width.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: A shared MCF7 name does not convert model assumptions into absolute assays. Current profilin input 50 differs from this model input 10 µM; its derived free pool cannot be substituted into the current tuple.
derivation_assumptions: Unstimulated steady state and high ATP
Assumed G/P/T totals 100/10/200 µM
Specified association/dissociation rates; barbed-end loss and pointed-end addition neglected
Bath jasplakinolide treated constant with rapid pointed-end inhibition
Initial molecular concentrations determined from best-fit B under the imposed totals/rates; do not count them as independently fitted observations
primary_cards.fit_parameter_distinction: The three actin concentrations are conditional derived initial values determined from fitted B and imposed total pools/rates; they are not three independently fitted parameters.

primary_cards.anchor: Fig. 1D; Methods: quantitative Western blotting and cell-volume determination

measured_context.cell: HT1080, B16F10, EL4, mouse BMDC and primary mouse neutrophils
measured_context.state: Cultured cell lines/primary preparations; not MCF7
measured_context.assay: Purified-protein-calibrated Western blots plus cell counting and fluorescence-exclusion whole-cell volume
measured_context.denominator: HALF measured whole-cell volume assumed accessible to soluble proteins

findings: HT1080 total actin 180±33 and PFN1 52±4 µM; B16F10 151±4 and 66±8; EL4 180±13 and 115±23.
BMDC total actin 192±12, PFN1 144±14 and PFN2 54±9 µM; neutrophils actin 196±35 and PFN1 111±18 µM.
These are total actin/profilin measurements. Profilin-actin concentration is subsequently inferred by near-saturation of profilin with actin.
The half-volume convention may overestimate concentrations by up to twofold if the entire measured volume is accessible, as the authors note.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Protein values mean±SD, N=3 independent experiments. Volume distribution is a separate sample: HT1080 2044±876 µm³, at least 300 cells/type. These do not provide matched per-cell covariance.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Total actin includes polymerized material and does not measure g_actin_total. Total PFN1 cannot by itself specify free profilin, profilin-actin, nucleotide state, or the MCF7 buffer pool.
derivation_assumptions: Profilin-actin estimate assumes abundant ATP soluble actin, rapid near-equilibrium binding and no sufficiently strong competing pool

measured_context.assay: Monomeric actin and thymosin measured; in-vitro 1:1 binding to platelet/muscle actin
measured_context.denominator: Cellular µM; original volume conversion not recovered

findings: Reported resting-platelet monomeric actin 280 µM and thymosin-β4 560 µM.
Platelet-actin binding Kd 0.4–0.7 µM; thymosin-actin 70–240 µM calculated using Kd 0.7 µM and assumed free-actin 0.1–0.5 µM.
primary_cards.uncertainty: No SD/SEM, replicate count or volume uncertainty identified in abstract. Kd/conditional complex ranges are not population SDs.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: The free-actin interval is a critical-concentration/capping assumption, not a direct intracellular free-actin measurement; resting platelet totals do not establish MCF7 values.

primary_cards.anchor: Results p. 323 and Discussion p. 327; Methods pp. 320–321

measured_context.assay: Western blot against chick ADF standard and silver-stained electrophoretic bands
measured_context.denominator: Percentage of total soluble protein; not directly µM in live accessible water

findings: Two immunoreactive species, 19 and 20 kDa. Western estimates 0.4% and 0.06% of soluble protein are minima because cross-reactivity is uncertain.
Silver staining instead gives about 0.4% and 1.3%; disagreement reflects assay/protein-identification limitations.
Discussion cites actin ~67 µM from prior work; the 60–85% monomer fraction refers to cold cell lysates.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Method-dependent estimates are not biological uncertainty intervals; sample-size/SD for a 20 µM cofilin estimate not found.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: This paper does not directly establish 20 µM human cofilin. Historical ADF/cofilin-family identity, phosphorylation, soluble fraction and mass-to-volume conversion require explicit resolution.

primary_cards.anchor: Quantitation of Arps p. 387; Results p. 392; fractionation/localization discussion

measured_context.assay: Quantitative immunoblotting with recombinant Arp standards, calibrated by Coomassie staining against actin
measured_context.denominator: Packed amoeba pellet; assumes 1 g pellet equals 1 mL

findings: Separate cellular concentrations: Arp2 1.9 µM and Arp3 5.1 µM. The paper reports Arp3 in excess of Arp2 and other complex subunits.
Cortical enrichment is localization evidence, not a calibrated cortical-shell aqueous concentration.
primary_cards.uncertainty: Numerical SD/CI and assay-specific n for the 1.9/5.1 estimates not located; fractionation replicate statements do not establish the n of concentration calibration.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Neither subunit concentration is automatically the concentration of intact, available Arp2/3 complexes. Current arp23.conc initializes a cortical-shell-water pool in static code; packed-cell average and shell concentration differ.

measured_context.assay: Cellular Arp2/3 concentration reported; full 1999 calibration method not recovered
measured_context.denominator: Cellular concentration; exact excluded-volume convention not verified

findings: Arp2/3 concentration 9.7 µM reported in human neutrophils.
primary_cards.uncertainty: No SD/SEM/n checked; one abstract point estimate.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Neither neutrophil state nor absolute compartment denominator matches the MCF7 cortical-shell free pool. A later WASp paper cannot substitute its volume assumptions for the 1999 Arp measurement.

primary_cards.anchor: Primary abstract: barbed-end capping, seed adsorption and immunoadsorption

measured_context.assay: High-speed lysate supernatant, submicromolar calcium, at least 100-fold cytoplasm dilution; spectrin-actin seed adsorption
measured_context.denominator: Estimated intact-cell concentration of free capper from lysate activity

findings: Available/free capper estimated at approximately 1–2 µM; the pool is functionally defined.
Removing more than 90% CPβ2 removed about 90% activity; extensive gelsolin removal did not reduce activity.
primary_cards.uncertainty: The 1–2 interval is an activity-derived estimate, not a reported SD or transferable concentration prior.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Functional free capper must not be equated to the declared inventory without the preparation stage: the finite constructor initially stores available CP as FREE_C, then initial tip binding consumes part of that pool. Extraction/dilution, species, cell state, volume and bound/free accounting remain unresolved.

measured_context.denominator: Fraction of profilin associated with monomeric actin

measured_context.assay: PA-GFP-actin, G/F proxy imaging and perturbation

findings: Cytosol-derived, Tβ4-dependent monomers supply the leading edge, while locally recycled lamellipodial monomers show a distinct dependence.

primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Supports keeping spatial and chemical pools distinct. It supplies no numeric MCF7 concentration, covariance or automatic joint equilibrium.

measured_context.assay: Quantifies G-actin-binding proteins, distinguishes phosphorylated/unphosphorylated ADF/cofilin
measured_context.denominator: Estimated average brain-cell concentration; heterogeneous tissue

findings: G-actin estimated 30–37 µM and Tβ4 50–60 µM; free critical actin estimated about 0.45 µM on day 13 and 0.2 µM on day 17.
Unphosphorylated soluble ADF:Tβ4 ratio shifts from 1:7 to 1:4; developmental conditions are separate observations.

primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Useful precedent for measuring related pools in matched samples, not a mammalian prior. Free concentrations are derived, and age/tissue ranges do not define uncertainty for a single cell state.

measured_context.denominator: mg actophorin per gram cells; actin:actophorin ratio

findings: Actophorin 0.4±0.1 mg/g cells; actin:actophorin about 10:1.
primary_cards.uncertainty: The abstract does not identify whether ±0.1 is SD, SEM or another uncertainty; n not recovered.
primary_cards.target_context: MCF7/native cell template; exact state, isoform and accessible-volume match not established
primary_cards.transfer_caveat: Actophorin is not automatically human CFL1; conversion to molar concentration requires molecular mass, cell/pellet density and an explicit accessible volume. No such replacement is proposed.

reference_registry.retrieval_scope: Primary full text and frozen KB SE514 identity audit

source_evidence_records.notes:
Two molecularly distinct G-actin pools feed lamellipodia: a cytosolic thymosin-beta4-bound monomer pool targeted to formins/leading edge (elevated G/F ratio for protrusion) and a locally recycled lamellipodial F-actin pool.

Relevance: Establishes non-homogeneous monomer pools + spatial targeting constraining the transport-limited actin-resupply model. Caveat: seed mis-placed it in PNAS; it is Cell Reports.

code_anchors.meaning: Separate soluble actin/P/T/CP inventories. ATP free and P/T-bound actin initialized; P/T inputs are buffer totals, CP enters free_cap; polymer inventory is explicitly separate.
Auxiliary activity solves sum(B_i*a/(Kd_i+a))=total-free with finite buffers. This activity need not equal separately imposed free concentration; code explicitly denies an equilibrium claim.
Cofilin concentration times pool volume times cytosolic-water fraction creates a finite molecule budget and decoration ceiling; does not identify chemically free/active cofilin in an assay.
Arp2/3 initial free count uses cortical-shell accessible water; activity factor is total water/shell water. This is a static formula, not evidence of current runtime consumption.
Growth pool V_geom=membrane.volume0−envelope.volume0; conc_unit=1/(602.214×V_geom), without water fraction. g_actin_free feeds base growth concentration. Optional unit chemistry is gated at line977.
Chemical bath uses V_geom×water_fraction; its Arp shell argument uses cortex_shell_volume×water_fraction.
Cortex thin-shell geometry uses 4πr_shell²h, with r_shell derived from cell radius, gap and half thickness.

conditional_mappings.expression: For an illustrative closed, homogeneous two-state population with constant rates: stationary f_assembled = k_a/(k_a+k_d); relaxation lambda = k_a+k_d; k_a=f_assembled*lambda; k_d=(1-f_assembled)*lambda.
conditional_mappings.required_observations: Same-context assembled/total object inventory plus an independently identifiable object-state relaxation or tracked birth/death exposure.
conditional_mappings.identifiability: A stationary assembled fraction identifies a ratio, not both rates. Protein FRAP, FRET dwell, STICS decorrelation, cluster threshold crossing and whole-object destruction have different observation operators.
assumptions: A fixed, tracked population with only the two modeled object states; no unmodeled entry, exit, merge or split.
Constant homogeneous positive transition rates in a matched condition and a stationary fraction measurement.
The relaxation observable identifies object-state relaxation, with detection, bleaching, censoring and motion distinguished.
This algebra is not a demonstration that a recorded native run or any cited fluorescence assay meets these assumptions.

conditional_mappings.target_denominator: Within each isoform, all allocated head owner IDs, including dormant objects: the fraction selected to own a crossbridge relation after isoform-specific integer rounding. Not the measured fraction of initially active, bound or force-producing heads.
conditional_mappings.required_observations: Calibrated phosphosite occupancy with explicit free/bound RLC denominator, plus independently validated mapping to head competence for isoform, assembly, ATP/load and cell state.
conditional_mappings.identifiability: Phospho-antibody intensity, phosphopeptide share, actin proximity, ATPase activity, duty occupancy and force-capable head fraction are separate observables.

conditional_mappings.expression: For a declared ROI projection, structural head count = object count * heads per object; active-force readout additionally depends on competence, binding occupancy, geometry and load.
conditional_mappings.identifiability: A single aggregate count-product or force projection generally leaves these factors unresolved; no full-model structural-identifiability result is asserted. Complementary calibrated measurements and an explicit observation operator are required.
conditional_mappings.target_area_definition: Initially assembled object density uses smooth mid-shell reference area 4*pi*r_shell^2; not membrane.area0, wrinkled area, planar optical ROI area or cortex volume.

relations.statement: Frozen code walks one MT node and sets rates v/(spacing*f), v/(spacing*(1-f)). Only static mean-cycle arithmetic is inspected. v=d*r requires fixed forward increments and compatible pause/backstep definitions. Head, dimer-centroid and cargo displacements are separate observables.

Frozen code uses stall_force as the exponential walking-transition and detachment force scale. The walking transition remains positive at finite force; the reprime transition is not force-scaled there. This differs from the definition of an experimentally measured zero-velocity stall.

TM09 workbook contains force-binned steps, dwells, linkage stiffness and velocity. Stable cross-sheet trace IDs are not established. DDB classes are not observed head-count labels. Retain paper/condition/trace hierarchy and quarantine pending parser, owner and source audit.

parameters.name: actin_chem.cofilin_decorated_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of built filament subunits carrying cofilin. THIS ROW STANDS IN FOR BINDING KINETICS THAT ARE NOT WIRED: no cofilin binding row exists in this file (nor on codex/bio-wiring-20260915, whose cofilin path is a 64-row molecular G/F preparation that is not ported), so the decoration cannot be computed from the file and is DECLARED. Sized from stoichiometry and from what cofilin does in a resting cell, not from any gate: one cofilin per actin protomer against actin_chem.cofilin_conc 20 uM and the filament this spec builds puts the hard ceiling at 0.0987 on the shipped build (1.021e7 molecules against 1.035e8 built protomers; cell/severing.decorated_fraction_ceiling recomputes it from the BUILT protomer count and refuses anything above it, with both counts in the message); and most cofilin in a resting cell is Ser3-phosphorylated and cannot bind F-actin at all, so the resting decoration sits well under that ceiling. 0.05 is an order-of-magnitude EXAMPLE inside it and a PI-GAP inference target, not a measurement. WARNING the real law (Kadzik 2026, aleph/laws/cofilin_severing.py) severs at decorated/bare BOUNDARIES and peaks at INTERMEDIATE decoration, while the uniform-rate form this row feeds is monotone in it — no run may claim the occupancy dependence. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

parameters.review_note: Declared occupancy placeholder; finite stoichiometric ceiling is not binding kinetics.

current_rows.name: chem.ph

declaration.source: cytosolic pH ~7.2. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

detail.law: pH sets the protonation of every rate that has an acid-base step (free Mg2+ speciating the nucleotide pool was the other half of this entry and is IMPLEMENTED — SPECIATION_ROWS)
detail.blocker: a pH-dependent rate needs a rate row measured AGAINST pH, and this corpus contains none: of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH at all (pinned by tests/product/cell/test_bounded_omissions.py). Verified again on 2026-09-21 by the bundle-kind/speciation lane over spec.example.toml and the codex/bio-wiring-20260915 source branch: no pH-dependent rate law exists on either. Writing one would be inventing a law, which the lane brief forbids, so this row STOPS here. The screening half of the old entry is also still unbuildable: no relation kind carries a charge, and giving one a charge is a resolution decision (see the bound), not a missing line of code
detail.bound: E' P2 / P3, two numbers. (i) SCREENING: at chem.ionic_strength 150 mM the Debye length is 0.8 nm — 1/56 of the SHORTEST interaction reach in the spec (erm.reach 45 nm) and 1/62 of resolution.spacing, so a screened term is exp(-56) = 3.7e-25 of an unscreened one at the closest distance this model resolves. (ii) SPECIATION, kept as the PREDICTION the device run is compared with now that the law is BUILT: at chem.mg_free 500 uM and chem.mgatp_kd 100 uM (a spec row since 2026-09-21; it was literature-only when this bound was written), [MgATP] is 0.8333 x chem.atp_conc, so the ATP-binding edge runs at 2500 /s instead of 3000 /s and the crossbridge cycle time 0.486 s (sum of 1/k_adp_release, 1/k_stroke, 1/k_pi_release, 1/k_hydrolysis, 1/(k_atp_bind x atp_conc)) lengthens by 0.014 %; even at a 10x weaker Kd of 1000 uM it is 0.137 %
detail.verdict: SMALL FOR THIS ENGINE — the screened term is below floating-point at the model's own resolution, and Mg-ATP speciation (now BUILT) moves the crossbridge cycle by 0.014 % (0.14 % at a 10x weaker Kd), far inside the spread the rate rows already declare. The honesty this number does NOT buy: chem.mg_free and chem.ph are often called "the conditions the rates were measured at", and reading the sources says otherwise — of the 10 SOURCED rate rows in the spec, ZERO state a pH, and the 3 that state Mg (Pollard 1986) state 1 mM TOTAL MgCl2 at 22 C in 50 mM KCl (ionic strength ~53 mM), not 0.5 mM FREE Mg at 150 mM. So the transfer error in those rows is UNBOUNDED by anything in this file; what is bounded here is only this engine's sensitivity. Closing that needs the sources read and their conditions written into the rows (a KB item, INVENTORY E' P3)

consistent species sums or specified chemical species, not a mixture of conventions

fixed or accounted pH, free Mg, ionic strength and temperature

fixed thermodynamic convention and environment

conditional_relations.statement: Debye length is a conditional calculation, not a second independent observation once ionic strength, permittivity and solution temperature are fixed.

uniform continuum permittivity and linearized electrolyte-screening approximation
same solution temperature/property context

parameter_reviews.name: crosslink.k

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

parameter_reviews.name: crosslink.molecular_model

declaration.source: WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

raw_declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 17:11 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crosslink-bell.md): the effective axial stiffness of the alpha-actinin LINKER between two cortex nodes, an elastic element with the bond's rest at the built distance. FERRER MISREAD CORRECTED: the former 4.6e5 ('455 pN/nm, Ferrer 2008 AFM') is Ferrer 2008 PNAS 105:9221 (10.1073/pnas.0706124105, SE119 OK; optical tweezers, not AFM) Hummer-Szabo fit k_BT*kappa_m = 455 +/- 215 pN/nm — the curvature of the actin-ABP BOND's energy well over x‡ 0.28 nm, not the 35-nm rod's stiffness; no direct measurement of the intact rod's axial stiffness exists (EXAMPLE). Two bounds put the value here: (i) self-consistency with crosslink.k_off0 — the resting thermal load sqrt(k_BT k) must be << f_char = k_BT/x_beta, i.e. k << f_char^2/k_BT = 5.7e4 pN/um (at 4.6e5 every bond carried 44 pN rms at rest, Bell x17, and 58 % tore in 10 us on RESULT-2026-09-11-motor-occupancy); (ii) the step — a 4.4-nm thermal kick at dt 1e-6 must not push the Bell exponent past 1: k <= 3.5e3. Molecule: 8 spectrin repeats per rod, folded-repeat stiffness ~1700 pN/nm each (Paramore 2005 MD), flexible terminal regions (Golji 2009), and the repeats UNFOLD at 25-35 pN (Rief 1999 JMB 286:553) below the 40-80 pN bond rupture. DESIGN ITEM (PI 17:11): the crosslink as a YIELDING element — this stiffness up to f_y ~25-35 pN, then ~30 nm of unfolded extension per repeat, refolding < 1 s on release (a bonds/builder change); until then this elastic element is the stand-in

relations.statement: XC01 jointly estimates escape parameters and bond-well curvature. Current whole-linker k is a different quantity; the source fit is not a fit of the current three inputs.
ABD kinetics, diffusion scaling and prior equilibrium affinity form a source-side inference chain; whole-protein association is not independently observed.
assumptions: Comparable reaction geometry for ABD and whole protein
Diffusion-controlled encounter approximation
KD and kinetic estimates share sufficiently compatible experimental definitions
Printed input arithmetic and 1993/1994 KD difference remain unresolved

relations.statement: Solution association [M−1s−1] cannot be substituted directly for the current [s−1] attempt clock.
assumptions: A valid mapping needs free-partner/site concentration and spatial encounter/availability/selection definition
Geometric capture and rate multiplication must not count the same encounter twice

relations.statement: Incumbent concentration-derived owner capacity is clipped by live cortex-node count; the finite molecular builder uses an unclipped molecule count. Neither count is automatically a measured doubly bound population.
Opt-in model assigns two arms per protein, each with 2k, L0/2 and koff0/2; each arm retains kon. These are code modeling conventions, not additional literature measurements.
assumptions: Series-stiffness equivalence presumes a compatible collinear configuration
Halving each arm hazard equates whole bridge loss only for first-arm failure from a doubly bound state with equal independent hazards; complete molecular escape with rebinding is different
Arms may bind the same filament
Host relation rows address the nearer material-segment node; exact device consumption of material-site overrides was not verified.

relations.statement: Force-ramp escape fit, solution/domain-derived rates, gel relaxation, cellular FRAP and loaded surface-bond lifetimes require separate observation models.
assumptions: Isoform, force geometry, bound-state definition, transport/rebinding and time censoring must match before any transfer

relations.statement: Full structural dimer length, central-rod length, Stokes radius, owner radius and capture distance are distinct quantities. Exact molecular mass additionally requires an isoform/sequence and oligomer definition.
Folded-repeat extension, domain unfolding, dimer pairing and full-link axial response are separate observables; domain-level data alone do not identify the current effective coefficient.
The raw k source says as-built rest distance; the frozen crosslink constructor supplies fixed crosslink.length. Neither is silently corrected in this review.
The current k declaration combines thermal and timestep-specific project bounds. Its interval is not a measured uncertainty band; U08 remains the immutable prior review.
assumptions: Temperature, Bell length and timestep conventions govern the stated project bounds
Do not infer a source covariance from sharing a formula
