source_code_anchors.interpretation: Incumbent concentration conversion uses geometric closed-surface volumes; kBT uses cell.temperature.
Two-state encounter and zero-force off rates; force scale kBT/x_beta; rest-length mode chosen by argument.
Incumbent crosslink construction passes crosslink.length as a fixed rest length, unlike the older as-built wording in crosslink.k source.
Opt-in molecular model removes the incumbent crosslink/filamin kind; this is static conditional code.
Incumbent capacity rounds concentration times geometric volume then caps by live owner-node count.
Finite molecular builder rounds concentration times its explicitly excluded-volume geometry without target-node clipping; no cytosolic-water factor here.
Opt-in two-arm model: two sites per protein, arm k=2 whole k, rest length=whole length/2, off=whole off/2, same-filament arms permitted.
Static transition kernel uses signed axial load with force-exponent clipping; it does not establish a measured molecular escape law.
Attachment candidate geometry and selection flags affect the interpretation of an encounter clock.
Attachment attempt probability uses the declared first-order rate and dt, before geometric candidate selection.

Host relation rows choose the nearer node of each selected material segment. This discrete address is separate from the source molecular binding endpoint; actual device override consumption was not tested.

limits: Static code was read at the frozen commit without cell/runtime imports, simulation, training, or native verification. Conditional paths are not claimed to have run.
No absolute MCF7 abundance, exact isoform-specific dimer mass, capture radius or whole-link small-extension stiffness was established.
Current same-fit memberships remain empty; source-estimation groups describe literature lineage only, never empirical covariance.
FRAP, equilibrium titration, force-ramp escape, loaded lifetimes, rheology and domain unfolding remain distinct quantities.
Rief and Miyata full text were not acquired; precise claims beyond their original abstracts remain unresolved.
All local full-text/image caches are ignored and must not be distributed with the compact review. Retrieval failures and superseded zero-result responses are not evidence.

Specify isoform, pulling endpoints, load regime and low-extension whole-dimer observable; adjudicate the rest-length prose/code difference separately.
Obtain Ferrer supporting methods to identify fit-parameter uncertainty convention and covariance if available; keep scalar errors and joint fitting distinct.
PI should state the coarse geometric/kinetic interpretation; source measurements alone cannot choose these representation conventions.

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 11:26 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-11-crossbridge-rates.md). ISOFORM ERROR CORRECTED: the former 0.35/s is NMIIB's unloaded ADP release (Kovacs 2007 Table 1: NM2B single-headed 0.38 +/- 0.09, HMM 0.27 +/- 0.06; Wang 2003). NMIIA — the engine's motor (hand_kmc.NMIIA_MYOSIN; x_adp derived for 2A) — is k0 = 2.7 +/- 0.3/s (single-headed, = Kovacs 2003 JBC 278:38132, 10.1074/jbc.M305453200, SE550 OK) / 2.9 +/- 1.0 (HMM); Stam 2015 carries 1.71/s from Kovacs 2003 -> spread: 1.7-2.9/s (lognormal prior, factor 1.3). Kovacs 2007 PNAS 104:9994 (doi 10.1073/pnas.0701181104, PMID 17548820, SE424 OK): resisting load slows it 5x (2A: 2.9 -> 0.59) / 12x (2B), assisting load speeds it 4x (11/s) — the load factors and x_adp were already 2A's, only the base rate was 2B's. Formerly: resisting load slows it 5x (2A) / 12x (2B) at ~2 pN, assisting load speeds it 4x. READ by bonds._crossbridge as the stroked state's detachment (2026-09-06, KB-2026-09-06 §4.8/§7.1b: unbound from the SWEPT k_off0). KB: SE424 Kovacs2007_PNAS, source_audit OK 2026-09-06 12:0x (key repaired from the encoding-stripped Kovcs2007; audit re-run). Spread: the paper gives ~0.35 /s (one significant figure), read as a factor of 1.4 either way

kb_record.provenance: in the 3-state kind detachment IS the rate-limiting ADP-release step (Kovacs 2007: NMIIA ADP release ~0.35 /s, load-sensitive) — bound, not copied

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Base versus IIB fallback, selector guard and three-state assignment. ADP release is a projected detachment; force scale f_stall exponentially suppresses the stroke rate, without a finite-force zero.
MgATP coefficient uses the Mg fraction before multiplying total ATP. This code conversion is not an empirical correction of the source buffer.
Extended cycles require k_pi_release and k_stroke to resolve to the same target, not merely equal values. Here ADP release preserves attachment and ATP binding detaches.
Free-head recovery and reversible ATP encounter rates. Both association coefficients use the same MgATP fraction; ratio is preserved.
Mode-1 stroke length magnitude is a marker; partner walks by chain topology. It is not a direct molecular nanometre displacement.
Frozen kernel uses only nonzero stroke marker for mode 1 and sets partner to _chain_target; chain-end saturation is separately counted.
First-order per-slot attempt precedes candidate geometry. A bimolecular actin association slope is not this hazard without a mapping.

parameter_reviews.name: envelope.mu_2d

declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

spec_declaration_snapshot.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §2: unbound from membrane.area_modulus — the nuclear envelope is TWO bilayers in parallel, so K_A = 2 x the single-bilayer value. Rawicz 2000 Biophys J 79:328 (10.1016/S0006-3495(00)76295-3, SE211, audit OK; KB-3.B1.3 verified/High) K_A = 243 mN/m +/- 10 % across 12 PCs = 2.43e5 pN/um -> 4.86e5 here. This is the GLOBAL area term (assemble.py k_area -> Surfaces.k_area, g = k_area/area0 * dA), additive to the mu_2d edge network's own areal response K_A = 2 mu_2d; the membranes are slack until envelope.excess_area = 0.30 is spent, which is why the lamina (Dahl 25 mN/m) and not the bilayers sets the measured NE stiffness. The lamina's own contribution is envelope.mu_2d + the lamina population, NOT this row.

raw_declaration.source: KB-2026-09-06-nuclear-envelope-shear-modulus §1: unbound from membrane.mu_2d — the plasma membrane's mu is carried by the spectrin/ERM-cortex, the NE's by the NPC-lamin connections; not the same quantity. NO source isolates the double-bilayer + NPC in-plane shear from the lamina's, because the lamin meshwork is its own population here (build/lamina.py). What the OK-verdict evidence constrains is the SUM envelope+lamina: Stephens 2017 MBoC 28:1984 (10.1091/mbc.E16-09-0653, audit OK) single-nucleus micromanipulation gives a short-extension spring 0.41-0.70 nN/um with 1.5-2.5x strain stiffening carried by lamin-A/C, i.e. a lamin-attributable 2.5e2-7.5e2 pN/um for a somatic mammalian nucleus (a shell spring k ~ C*mu, C = O(1) — order of magnitude, not a modulus). The lamina as BUILT already delivers 1.3e2-5.1e2 pN/um (EA = material.if.E * pi * material.if.radius^2 = 471 pN over lamina.filament = 0.4 um -> k_edge 1178 pN/um; mu = sqrt(3)k/4 = 510 affine, 128 after the z=4.5 vs z_c=4 knockdown), so 2.5e2 here puts the sum at 3.8e2-7.6e2 pN/um, inside the measured band. Ceiling 2.5e4 = Dahl 2004 J Cell Sci 117:4779 (10.1242/jcs.01357, audit OK, SE562): 25 mN/m network elastic modulus, micropipette aspiration of ISOLATED XENOPUS OOCYTE envelopes — an amphibian lamin-B-rich oocyte NE, 30-100x above the somatic band, and Swift 2013 (10.1126/science.1240104, audit OK) is why it may not be transferred to a human somatic cell unqualified. Dahl does not split K_A from mu; the engine's triangular network fixes K_A = 2 mu, and the measured K/mu is 1.5 +/- 0.3 (HeLa, Rowat 2005) to 5.1 +/- 1.3 (WT MEF, Rowat 2006) — both PENDING SE registration, see the KB doc §3. Its own K_edge = 4 mu_2d / sqrt(3) = 577 pN/um per envelope edge (PLAN-2026-09-03ab §1), x25 tonight's 23.094: the envelope's in-plane branch moves 1.9e5 -> 4.7e6 /s (object_spectra_20260905T152006Z), still below the IF/MT branches. The gate is NOT this row: aspirate the built nucleus and score k_short / k_long against Stephens 0.41-0.70 nN/um and 1.5-2.5x.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Domain count/diameter set geometry; mass is density times domain volume distributed over subdivisions. Resolution binding subdivides links; only one compliant row retains the domain-link coefficient. Static source only.
Ns outermost domain centres link to nearest lamina node. Nc=round(f*N/2) counts drawn pairs; only adjacent indices are rejected, with no distinct-domain or duplicate-pair filter in this block.

L determines N=round(4πR²/L²), then k-nearest neighbours and symmetric union determine topology. Refined IF-material segments have their own mass; areal-density mass is additionally assigned to original vertices. Component interpretation requires PI review.
Nuclear radius and wavelength/radius enter a common geometrical wrinkle field; resolution controls the mesh.

The wrinkled closed geometry supplies area0 and volume0; declared mass, tension, bending, pressure and converted edge coefficient are surface inputs. This is a static construction, not evidence of achieved runtime shape.
The double_sheet selector builds a separate inner sheet only when equal to one; current frozen declaration is zero. This is a model selector, not measured absence of the biological inner membrane.
Triangular-network conversion K_edge=4*mu_2d/sqrt(3), with implied area response 2*mu_2d. This lattice relation does not identify an experimental isolated-envelope shear modulus.
lamina.turnover_rate is assigned to rest-length relaxation of unconstrained segments; it is not a measured molecular replacement event count.
Rest lengths relax exponentially toward current segment length with factor exp(-rate*dt), optionally with thermal noise. No invocation or dynamics tested.

GSER-based apparent modulus at selected lag; eta=G_loss/omega. Declared rows are comparison targets only; source explicitly warns about tethered probes and active motion. It does not compute Tseng eta_s=plateau_Gprime*relaxation_time as the same operation.
Area and volume moduli enter Surfaces; bending-law selector can move the coefficient into a separate curvature law. Does not verify which branch ran.

Area law sigma=sigma0+K_A*max(A/A0-1,0); volume law p=p0+K_V*(V0-V)/V0 under declared guards. K_V is a linear finite-volume constitutive coefficient here, not an independently verified nuclear osmotic law.

registered_source_evidence_rows.notes: Native cortical actin mesh architecture (EM). Control (unperturbed) cortex = homogeneous mesh, gap ~30 nm. mDia1 depletion -> high-density patches + 100-200 nm gaps; both nucleators (mDia1 + Arp2/3) perturbed -> loose mesh >100 nm. mDia1 and Arp2/3 each nucleate ~half of cortical F-actin. Cells: HeLa / M2. IMPLICATION for ffn_sim: the KB 'actin mesh ~100 nm' (KB-3.1/3.18) is the PERTURBED/loose value, NOT native; native ~30 nm. This vindicates the 70,686 count MAGNITUDE (implied mesh ~34 nm, native regime) and RETRACTS the earlier 'count too dense' concern. Registered per PI 2026-07-21. See docs/v2_audit/CORTEX_COUNT_CROSSCHECK_2026-07-21.md. TODO (PI-gated KB edit): re-label KB-3.1/3.18 mesh 100 nm as perturbed + add native 30 nm.

source_cards.finding: Control Table1: rates1.38±0.1/s and0.04±0.01/s, fast fraction0.69±0.06. Text reports recovery half-time12.8±1s; Table2 reports8.6±1s for cortical FRAP and an effective0.04±0.01/s. Their coexistence is retained. Background20-25s cites earlier studies. Table1 exact0.03/s is a slow component under1µM cytochalasin D, not an unperturbed whole-cortex constant.
source_cards.limits: Single exponential identity is τ=1/k and t1/2=ln2/k; mixture summaries do not obey a one-rate reduction. Frozen observer counts live→dead nodes per time, a different numerator/denominator. SE110 has blank DOI and NO_DOI_FOUND; this candidate DOI is not a registry repair. Report-level half-time differences are retained without asserting the same cohort or an error. A scalar0.03/s could approximately correspond to ln(2)/(20–30s)=0.0231–0.0347/s under a single-exponential half-time interpretation; this possible approximation does not establish the declaration’s exact derivation or equivalence to the node-based observer.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Primary plus/minus values preserved; no SD/SEM type or source-wide aggregation inferred beyond inspected captions. Different main-text/Table2 half-times and N remain unresolved; the inspected text does not establish identical cohort membership. Fig.2B/D curve error bars are labeled SD, but that alone does not determine the meaning of ± attached to Table1 fitted rates.

registered_source_evidence_rows.notes: Cytosim theory/simulation of disordered actomyosin cortex networks (the reference engine lineage for ffn_sim filament mechanics). METHODOLOGICAL anchor: filament count is SET EXPLICITLY, not derived from concentration/geometry -- e.g. ~1,500 filaments over a circular patch of radius 15 um (~707 um^2) = ~2 filaments/um^2, chosen to reproduce network mechanics. IMPLICATION for ffn_sim: 'areal density x surface = 70,686' is one convention, not the field standard; the 100/um^2 areal density is a modeling choice, and 70,686 x 3um are coarse REPRESENTATIVE filaments, not a short-filament census. review_snapshot.name: cortex.proximal_fraction

declaration.source: the fraction of cortex filaments laid in the membrane-proximal HALF of the shell (build/cortex._depth; 0.5 = uniform through the thickness, the pre-2026-09-17 build). The cortex is densest under the membrane (Clark 2013 Biophys J 105:570 — cortical actin within ~100-200 nm of the membrane, thickness profile from super-resolution; Chugh 2017 Nat Cell Biol 19:689 — thickness/density set by the length distribution): a value above 0.5 puts that structure in. RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.15: at 0.5, 9.1 % of membrane vertices are farther than erm.reach (45 nm) from any cortex segment at build. Not sourced as a number; SET 0.8 on 2026-09-17 11:15 from the build measurement (RESULT-2026-09-15 s10.16, NMII minifilaments on the same profile): membrane vertices beyond erm.reach 9.1 % (0.5) -> 2.4 % (0.8), NMII heads beyond crossbridge.reach 14.4 % -> 12.8 %; 0.9 was not taken (the profile then has 90 % of the cortex in 100 nm, beyond what the density literature supports).

parameter_reviews.name: erm.areal_density

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §6): the only measured membrane-cortex linker density — Diz-Munoz, Krieg, Bergert, ..., Paluch, Heisenberg 2010 PLoS Biol 8:e1000544 (10.1371/journal.pbio.1000544), dynamic AFM tether spectroscopy on zebrafish mesendoderm progenitors: 41 nm mean lateral spacing = ~600/um^2, strongly reduced by DN-ezrin / ezrin-MO; T_app 46 uN/m, static tether 25-32 pN. Count is CAPACITY; the build starts the population at occupancy k_on/(k_on+k_off0) (a693ab1f). Harvester candidates, not yet in source_audit

parameter_reviews.name: erm.k_on

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §2, §6). Sourced as the DATASET pair with erm.k_off0 = 1.3/s (PI decision J): every in-cell observation needs occupancy 0.75-0.9 — Coscoy 2002 PNAS 99:12813 (10.1073/pnas.192084599) two-photon FRAP, 25 % of membrane ezrin exchanging on tau = 5.7 s, rest on 1-2 min; Alert 2015 rho_b*/rho_0 ~ 0.9; Diz-Munoz 2010 density — and with k_off0 1.3 that occupancy is k_on*P ~ 4-12/s (0.88 at 10). Only k_on*P(reach) is identifiable (laws/erm_kinetics). The former '1e4/s (Alert 2015)' is DELETED: Alert's Table 1 takes k_on 1e4 and k_off0 10 from Rognoni 2012 PNAS (10.1073/pnas.1211274109), a FILAMIN Ig20-21 measurement, and fits only chi = k_off/k_on. STATED RESIDUAL: this pair relaxes to occupancy in ~90 ms, while ezrin re-covers a bare bleb membrane in ~5 s (Charras 2006 JCB 175:477, 10.1083/jcb.200602085: ezrin precedes actin by 4.9 +/- 3 s) — a bleb-healing row is ~50x too fast with this pair; the in-cell pair (k_on ~0.2, k_off ~0.03-0.2) needs a re-ratification of k_off0 = a two-row PI decision, OPEN. No mus/ms row sees the difference

parameter_reviews.name: erm.reach

declaration.source: PI signature 2026-09-11 00:35 (Lead transcript 14373ea7; KB-2026-09-1x-erm-kon-reach §3, §6). A pairing filter on the node lattice, not a bond length: the native cortex has 4.59 M nodes in a 0.2 um shell (~0.031 um apart) with its edge at depth 0.018-0.020 um, so a membrane vertex's nearest cortex NODE is at median 0.034 um and the former 0.025 paired 8-11 % of vertices (RESULT-2026-09-10-fixed-build-first-row; Monte-Carlo erm_reach_coverage.json: 0.045 -> 92 %, 0.050 -> 98 %). Inside the molecule: ERM monomer span 10-50 nm, live membrane-cortex boundary gap <10 / <=20 nm (Clausen ... Fritzsche, Eggeling 2017 J Phys D 50:064002, 10.1088/1361-6463/aa52a1, STED on live Jurkat). Every pair RESTS at its built distance (bonds.attach; occupy_at_build a693ab1f) so no initial-load cap is needed — Bell at erm.k 4600 and x_beta 0.7 nm gives k_off(115 pN) ~ 2e8/s, a pair rested at r0 with 25 nm of stretch would die in one step. erm.r0 = 0.020 is the unstressed span. Replaces PI-GAP card E4

source_cards.title: Braunger 2014: rupture-fit parameters and separately estimated stiffness

registered_source_evidence_rows.short_source: Braunger J, Brückner BR, Nehls S, Pietuch A, Gerke V, Mey I, Janshoff A, Steinem C. Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate alters the number of attachment sites between ezrin and actin filaments: a colloidal probe study. J Biol Chem. 2014;289(14):9833-9843.
registered_source_evidence_rows.notes: Single ezrin–F-actin bond stiffness k_b = 4.6 pN/nm (N≈1 bond) via colloidal-probe AFM; as-measured system stiffness k_sys = 2.2 pN/nm (cantilever k_c≈40 pN/nm in series). Unbinding force ≈50 pN (WT 50 / T567D 58 / T567A 43 pN); k_off = 1.3 s⁻¹; barrier width 0.7 nm. Perpendicular detachment geometry. Source for k_erm (KB-3.B1.6). DOI verified via PubMed PMID 24500715 / PMC3975028.
registered_source_evidence_rows.anchor_status: OK

source_audit_rows.note: CrossRef: braunger 2014 — Phosphatidylinositol 4,5-Bisphosphate Alters the Number of Attachment

source_cards.primary_anchor: Experimental Procedures; Figs.7–8; Discussion stiffness analysis

conditions.construct: Recombinant N-His6 ezrin; force-rate fit uses T567D on Ni-NTA AFM tip (~30 nm radius), F-actin on charged gold. Ezrin species not established from accessed expression description.
conditions.buffer: 20 mM Tris-HCl pH7.4, 50 mM KCl, 0.2 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM EDTA/NaN3; 200 pN contact load, 1 s dwell.

source_cards.observational_unit: Rupture forces versus loading rate; force-curve stiffness distribution.
source_cards.finding: Fig.8 Evans–Ritchie fit yields off-rate 1.3/s and barrier width 0.7 nm. Discussion obtains 4.6 pN/nm from stiffness mean/variance under a Poisson bond-number estimate (~1), with a stiff-transducer approximation.
source_cards.limits: The stiffness estimate is a separate analysis, not a third parameter of the same force-rate fit. No association rate measured; no temperature conversion to 310 K established.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Fig.8: 28 independent experiments; Fig.7: 5. No uncertainty interval located for 1.3/s, 0.7 nm or 4.6 pN/nm.

source_cards.title: Diz-Muñoz 2010: active-link density inferred from dynamic tethers
source_cards.primary_anchor: Fig.1H; Fig.S2G; Table S1; Materials and Methods dynamic tether model

conditions.cell_state: Isolated zebrafish prechordal-plate progenitors; control and ERM-perturbed conditions, not MCF7.
conditions.assay: ConA AFM tethers, 100 pN contact, 0–0.6 s dwell, 1–50 um/s pulling; DMEM/F12, within 1 h of seeding.
conditions.temperature: AFM temperature not located; 28 C belongs to a different imaging protocol.
conditions.model_inputs: Lipid-permeation regime; fixed bending rigidity 2.9e-19 N m, membrane viscosity 1.5e-7 Pa m s, and lipid tension 2.5 uN/m from LatA.

source_cards.observational_unit: Dynamic tether-force observations; fitted active crosslinkers per membrane area.
source_cards.finding: Approximate 600/um² and 41 nm spacing describe one inferred density, not two independent measurements. Inverse-area spacing convention gives 1/(0.041 um)^2 ≈595/um². Static control median is 32 pN (114 tethers/56 cells); 25 pN belongs to a distinct curve-selection comparison.
source_cards.limits: The estimate depends on fixed mechanical inputs. Active bound-link density does not directly equal allocated ERM capacity. Same-cell AFM/FRAP pairing and MCF7 transfer not established; universal “only measured density” claim not verified.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Fig.1H/S2G uncertainty propagated from fit, not population SD. Table S1 separates tether and cell counts; repeated tethers are not independent cells.

source_cards.title: Coscoy 2002: ezrin FRAP fractions and nonunique short-time fit
source_cards.primary_anchor: Table1; Fig.4e; Results restricted recovery and time-lapse FRAP

conditions.cell_state: Confluent LLC-PK1 epithelial microvilli, tagged ezrin constructs.
conditions.assay: Local two-photon bleach (~1 um volume), 50 ms bleach and 10 s recovery; separate time-lapse protocol uses a 5x20 um band and 7 s sampling.

source_cards.observational_unit: Fluorescence recovery fraction and time scale, with cytoplasmic/membrane-pool denominators.
source_cards.finding: WT fast/slow pools are approximately 30%/70% of total signal. Under the reaction-limited interpretation, about 25% of the membrane pool exchanges on the short scale. Fig.4e reaction-fit tau=5.7 s and slow-diffusion fit D≈0.1 um²/s both describe the record. Separate slow recovery has typical half-time 1–2 min.
source_cards.limits: Exchanging fraction is not the mechanically occupied fraction. A FRAP tau is not automatically microscopic k_off or 1/(k_on+k_off); diffusion, pool exchange and reporter geometry differ. The paper does not identify current k_on=10/s.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: Fig.4 intensity curves use SEM; WT n=117 and internally tagged n=118 measurements. No tau=5.7 s confidence interval located.

source_cards.title: Charras 2006: ezrin-to-actin arrival delay is not whole bleb healing
source_cards.primary_anchor: Fig.5D and caption; kinetics of cortex reassembly; Imaging methods

conditions.cell_state: Blebbing filamin-deficient human melanoma M2 cells, actin/ezrin reporters.
conditions.assay: Detectable fluorescence arrival relative to actin time zero, images every 1 s for 120 s; at most 5 blebs/cell and at least 5 cells per protein.

source_cards.observational_unit: Between-reporter arrival delay per bleb, not an individual binding event.
source_cards.finding: Ezrin appears 4.87±3 s before actin (23 blebs); reported error is SD. Assembly of the complete contractile cortex is described on an approximately 30 s scale.
source_cards.limits: The 4.87 s delay does not measure recovery of bare membrane, a first-order ERM relaxation time, or a microscopic association/off-rate. It cannot by itself establish a “50x too fast” kinetic mismatch.
source_cards.reported_uncertainty: 4.87±3 s is mean±SD over n=23 blebs, not 23 independent cells.

source_cards.title: Alert 2015: conditional adhesion theory and borrowed kinetic inputs

conditions.construct: FNIII7–10 against recombinant alpha5beta1-Fc or headpiece; native human vascular smooth-muscle integrin reconstituted in a bilayer as control.

source_cards.observational_unit: Bond lifetime conditional on clamped force, cations, construct and capture linkage.
source_cards.finding: For full extracellular alpha5beta1-Fc, lifetimes increase over10–30 pN. At >30 pN in Mg/EGTA or Mn, the Fc–GG7 capture linkage can limit lifetime; the Ca/Mg branch supports a distinct high-force interpretation. For the truncated headpiece, the capture linkage limits the measured serial-bond lifetime above25 pN in all three cation conditions.
source_cards.limits: This is not a direct measurement of a complete integrin–talin–actin clutch, its2 pN force scale, or k_on0.3/s. Multiple lifetime populations and capture controls constrain interpretation. Frozen citation key says Nature, but DOI/article are JCB; raw registry retained.

relations.statement: Braunger off-rate/barrier width share a loading-rate fit; stiffness comes from another inference. The frozen force scale kBT/x_beta changes with temperature without establishing temperature transfer of off-rate.
assumptions: Same construct, loading geometry and fit convention are required; no unreported covariance is reconstructed.

relations.statement: Diz active-link density is model inferred. Frozen areal_density allocates potential owners; actual built bound count also depends on reach, candidate geometry and stationary-state draw. Density and spacing are one inferred quantity.
assumptions: Density×area applies only to the correct membrane area denominator. Build count is capped at node count. No native count or reachable fraction was measured in this pass.

relations.statement: FRAP recovery and ezrin-before-actin delay do not directly identify current two-state rates. In a closed constant-rate two-state system only, stationary occupancy would be on/(on+off) and relaxation rate on+off.
assumptions: Identical tracked states and populations, fixed rates, zero load, no diffusion/recruitment or changing geometry, and an appropriate observation/error model are prerequisites. Neither paper establishes them for frozen ERM.

relations.statement: Alert borrows filamin-associated kinetics and predicts critical occupancy conditional on a membrane-adhesion model. No automatic filamin→ezrin rate or critical→ordinary occupancy transfer follows.
assumptions: Exact Rognoni branch for the rounded1e4/10 pair remains unresolved without SI. Tethered first-order closure and free-solution association have different denominators.

relations.statement: Clausen boundary-gap inference supplies geometry context. Frozen erm.r0 sets cortex location, while ERM pairs rest at their own built separation and reach filters eligible node pairs.
assumptions: Imaging peak/boundary definitions, labeling, PSF, cell type and mesh geometry must be aligned; no measured microscopic rest-length distribution is recovered.

relations.statement: Count=density×adhesion area is dimensional bookkeeping only after receptor identity, active fraction and area denominator are fixed. Model clutch count is not a measured surface integrin census.
assumptions: Need heterodimer/state, local basal adhesion area versus whole-cell membrane area, bound/available fraction and molecules per effective clutch. None is supplied by the16-row scope.

relations.statement: Author thesis and later model tables differ; direct alpha5beta1 lifetime data do not identify the entire clutch linkage parameters. Current numeric matches do not establish a shared fit or covariance.
assumptions: Resolve original Science SI before choosing a version attribution. Align force signs, capture-bond limitations, cations and effective-linkage definition before any mechanistic comparison.

relations.statement: Sensor response up to8 pN supplies conditional force context, not uniform endogenous force, stiffness or census. Frozen linc.tension is an observer comparison; linc.areal_density sets only lamina_envelope population.
assumptions: Stiffness requires matched force-extension observations. Force-per-object/count transfer requires endogenous construct and load-path mapping. Observer target/median(k) is a hypothetical shortening diagnostic, not a measured extension.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Two-state rates read erm.k_on/k_off0; force scale kBT/x_beta; no positive explicit rest length means as_built. Static declaration only.
ERM receives no fixed rest length. Both LINC relation kinds use linc.k.
ERM areal density allocates owner capacity, capped at membrane node count and weighted by represented area; not an observed bound-link count.
Build draws stationary states, applies node reach and partner admissibility, then marks only finite bound candidates alive; ERM rest is built separation. No native occupancy measured here.
erm.r0 shifts the cortex shell geometry, alongside membrane sagitta and half-thickness. It is not passed as ERM fixed bond rest length.
linc.areal_density samples lamina_envelope owners per envelope area, capped by lamina node count. linc_if instead selects the first node of each IF strand.
linc.tension is an axial-load comparison target. target/median(k) is a hypothetical shortening diagnostic, not imposed prestress or measured extension.
Frozen suspended specimen marks integrin engagement and clutch absent until a distinct adherent preparation; declaration is not proof of active relations.

parameter_reviews.name: microtubule.dimer_rise

declaration.source: the lattice rise of one tubulin dimer, 8 nm — the end-stroke unit delta of the microtubule family, which is what makes growth_speed a DERIVED on-rate: k_on = growth_speed / (dimer_rise * tubulin_conc) [1/(uM.s)] and the shrink off-rate k_off_b = shrink_speed / dimer_rise [1/s]. LOAD HAZARD, stated where the number is: the on-law multiplies by exp(f*delta/kT), so with delta = 0.008 um and kT = 4.28e-3 pN.um (310 K) one pN of slot load is exp(1.87) = 6.5x and 10 pN is exp(18.7) = 1.3e8 — end_growth clamps the exponent at 50 (f = 26.8 pN), which is a runaway, not a limit. The microtubule family therefore runs under the DECLARED zero load (growth_load = 'zero', the live operating point for actin too); growth_load = 'stretch' is refused for it in assemble.wire_growth. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

review_snapshot.name: microtubule.dimer_rise

declaration.source: the lattice rise of one tubulin dimer, 8 nm — the end-stroke unit delta of the microtubule family, which is what makes growth_speed a DERIVED on-rate: k_on = growth_speed / (dimer_rise * tubulin_conc) [1/(uM.s)] and the shrink off-rate k_off_b = shrink_speed / dimer_rise [1/s]. LOAD HAZARD, stated where the number is: the on-law multiplies by exp(f*delta/kT), so with delta = 0.008 um and kT = 4.28e-3 pN.um (310 K) one pN of slot load is exp(1.87) = 6.5x and 10 pN is exp(18.7) = 1.3e8 — end_growth clamps the exponent at 50 (f = 26.8 pN), which is a runaway, not a limit. The microtubule family therefore runs under the DECLARED zero load (growth_load = 'zero', the live operating point for actin too); growth_load = 'stretch' is refused for it in assemble.wire_growth. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

parameter_reviews.name: arp23.nucleation_reserve_fraction

declaration.source: SHIPPED AT 0 SINCE 2026-09-21 (device, RunPod A100, 353b9c858): with births on, the woken daughters carried 6.8e3 -> 3.8e5 -> 1.2e6 pN within five steps and the all-on cell went non-finite at k = 3; with this row at 0 the same cell is clean (free:cortex force_max 4-17 pN). Cause: a chain born at runtime is NOT in the axial-constraint workspace, so its nodes take independent thermal draws (~1.3 um per 1e-2 s step) against EA/L ~ 9e5 pN/um rows. The law is implemented (physics/chain_birth) and stays inert until the workspace can admit a born chain; 0.1 was the lane's value (1.66 s of births at the ceiling rate). dormant DAUGHTER chain records per built cortex chain, because a branch is a new CHAIN and the chain count is fixed at construction (the same device as actin_chem.severing_reserve_fraction, and they are summed in the layout — one reserve stack, one count per consumer). DERIVED from the rows beside it, not tuned: arp23.conc 2 uM over the cortical shell's water = 1.154e5 free complexes x arp23.nucleation_rate 0.037 /s = 4.27e3 nucleations/s against 7.07e4 built chains, so 0.1 (7.07e3 records) is 1.66 s of nucleation at the ceiling and 3.3 s at the stationary flux (cortex.turnover_rate x the chain count). THAT IS LESS THAN THE 2.5 s COMPRESSION PROTOCOL at the ceiling: a run that outlives its reserve SATURATES and the step is counted (physics/chain_birth no_record), never raised, and the record's saturation step is what a claim must be read against. Sized at 0.1 because each record costs two dead segment rows and NO node, but a woken one takes three nodes from cortex.dormant_fraction's pool, which is 4.3e5 nodes — 7.07e3 x 3 = 2.1e4 of them, 5 % of that pool. not in KB source_audit — register before SOURCED

NO rate constant for espin, fimbrin, I-plastin or villin exists anywhere in this corpus — searched 2026-09-21 over aleph/references, aleph/docs, aleph/laws and this file; every hit says UNSOURCED (KB-DRAFT-3-23, SE_REGISTRATION_CANDIDATES_2026-06-30, architecture_spec.py 'espin/fimbrin STAND-IN'). source_code_anchors.interpretation: Filamin whole-link kind combines two force-modulated exits from bound state. Slip .087/s and catch .1/s sum to .187/s at zero force in this table, not the lone Ferrer HS zero-force rate. length sets fixed whole-link rest length; reach is capture radius. Static comparison only.

Bundler length is a geometry admissibility check against packing reach. k_on is read as first-order slot association; off and Bell length define force-dependent slot exit. Default rest mode is as-built, not the declared span. Three slots per coarse node are not three molecules per actin subunit.
Owner-node filamin capacity is concentration times cytoplasm volume, capped by live owner nodes; total protein and active molecule inventory require a separate mapping.
Bundler slots are live coarse nodes repeated sites_per_node times, resolving distinct-neighbor topology. No measured fascin:actin ratio is read here.

Build reserve sums severing and nucleation fractions. Branch triple uses pi/2 plus declared branch_angle and declared angular stiffness; microscope junction angle is not the triple angle without geometry conversion.
Reserve enables allocation and is ceiled per built chain. Per-site coefficient distributes per-free-complex nucleation rate over sites; no NPF population is read in this span.
Arp pool uses cortical-shell water volume and concentration; activity normalization uses world/shell volume. Total-cell subunit abundance is a different denominator.

Formin elongation_factor scales association, not release. Distinct free/CP-bound regulatory states use separate rates and free-formin pool; a net measured velocity ratio is not automatically this association multiplier.

Module documents selector 0 owner-node whole links and selector 1 explicit two-arm massive molecules. MW/radius/arm capture geometry belong to the latter interpretation, not a measured whole-link stiffness.
Explicit-molecule builder returns early unless molecular_model==1; mass/drag/count and arm geometry are conditional static consumers, not verified native usage.

Arp junction has a load-independent bound-to-free rate debranch_rate and separate axial k. Acquiring edge is conditional on nucleation.wanted and receives later coefficient scaling. Static row meaning only.
BondKind default rest_len_mode is as_built. Bundler constructor does not override it, unlike the filamin fixed-length constructor.

declaration.source: WHICH crosslinker representation the build uses, and the ONE row that chooses it. 0 = the incumbent owner-node idiom (the crosslinker is a relation owned by a filament node; cell/bonds.build_kinds). 1 = the finite two-arm MOLECULE of codex/bio-wiring-20260915 (cell/build/crosslinkers.build_two_arm_crosslinker): a massive freely hinged centre node per molecule, two independent arms of length/2 and stiffness 2k, population = conc x actual cytoplasm volume. The two are different physics, not a refactor: the owner-node idiom cannot represent a 0.16 um rod whose capture radius is smaller than its own length without every bond being born compressed, and the two-arm model has no such defect; the molecule model in turn needs the material-site machinery on the device before its arms bind exact monomer sites rather than segment endpoints. Default 0 until one device run compares them. Companion rows (<prefix>.molecular_weight, .radius, .arm_reach) are read only at 1.

parameter_reviews.name: membrane.inplane_friction

declaration.source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

review_snapshot.name: membrane.inplane_friction

declaration.source: PI-GAP, and a STAND-IN that is to be REPLACED rather than sourced. The in-plane flow law v = grad(sigma)/b needs a drag per unit area per unit in-plane velocity; membrane-cortex friction is reported around 1e8-1e9 Pa.s/m (tether-pulling and flow measurements of the Shi/Baumgart kind; 1 Pa.s/m = 1e-6 pN.s/um^3, so 1e2-1e3 in these units) — quoted from memory, NOT read in a paper here and NOT in the KB source_audit, hence EXAMPLE and hence a range that is exploratory and not a confidence interval. The PI's decision (OPTIONS-2026-09-21 item 3) is that this coefficient should EMERGE from the making and breaking of the explicit ERM relations that tie the bilayer to the cortex, the way composite viscosity must be an observable and not an input (directive 9). This row exists so the flow law can run before that emergence is built, and is to be deleted when it is.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Grid box is from maximum absolute constructed node coordinate plus padding, rounded symmetrically, or a declared even count; not a measured cell radius alone.
Caller measures closed-surface face spacing, checks a declared band, selects collocated or MAC grid, and reads solvent viscosity.
Spacing check is 1/factor <= dx/measured_spacing <= factor. No biological sampling distribution is defined.
MAC per-axis cell count rounds up to 16 with origin fixed at lower corner. Static constructor reading only.
Density enters this Reynolds guard using unloaded motor reference speed, not a fluid inertial mass term in this inspected block.
Switch is read through a named constant; when enabled the declared reference conversion is checked against R*Tref.
Built enclosed volumes, cytosol/nuclear water fractions and finite bath set pool water volumes and initial solute counts.
The enabled transport path refuses simultaneous nonzero static surface pressure or volume modulus in this scope.
Non-bath water volumes use signed surface incidence minus fixed nonwater; bath takes residual. Pi uses kBT times molecule count/water volume differences.
Inspected transport requires a MAC grid, no held pressure outlet, and reflection exactly 1; other reflection needs absent cross-flux state.
Zero slip gives two exact tangent constraint rows per face. Positive length gives drag per area 2*eta/b for two solvent sides.
Transport chemistry initializes from bonds.kbt(p), only after the switch-dependent inputs succeed.
kBT uses cell.temperature and exact Boltzmann unit conversion, independent of osmotic.reference_temperature.
Cortical shell water fraction also rescales the source-site coefficient; shared use is not empirical covariance.
Chemistry receives cytosolic compartment water and separate cortical shell water, both multiplied by the water-fraction input.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: n_backbone is a numerical node count; backbone segment length is contour-input/(n_backbone-1). Assembled count and reserved objects are obtained before placement. No molecular stoichiometry measurement follows from the node count.

Head coordinates are displaced transversely from backbone anchor beads by head_offset. This is not a longitudinal bare-zone distance or molecular lever-arm length. arm_seg refines the numerical chain.

Builder assigns axial coefficient EA/rest and bending coefficient kappa/segment_length, with separate arm orientation and internal-arm triples. It also flags backbone segments constrained. Coefficient construction alone does not demonstrate its active runtime force contribution. Radius-dependent mass uses half-segment cylinders at endpoints, not an isolated spherical motor-head mass.

Rigid-lever chord comparison computes 2 asin(stroke/(2 lever_arm)) subject to positive lengths and stroke<=2 lever_arm. This geometric check is not an experimental joint fit; source comments claiming independent measurements remain unadjudicated.

object_life is a 0/1 selector. Assembled and dormant reserve counts use a conditional closed two-state stationary ratio; the selector is not a measured lifetime and does not establish biochemical equivalence of intact dormant objects and free folded molecules.

Counts are rounded motor count times cargo fraction, summed over motor classes. Each carrier is one free node with mass=density*(4/3)*pi*radius^3 and unresolved membrane. This differs from a vesicle bearing an experimentally variable motor team.

The current generic motor pool is divided by an object-count fraction into MT-owning sliding and cargo-owning roles; rates are shared by bindings. KIF5-like dimers and Eg5 tetramers, or cortical dynein and activated DDB, are not shown to be one measured interconverting molecular pool by this bookkeeping.
The declared lever-arm/chord result is returned as build metadata. Inspecting this does not establish realized stepping amplitude or native runtime behavior.

parameter_reviews.name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

parameter_reviews.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

record_snapshot.name: sim.inplane_count_floor_fraction

declaration.source: positivity guard, not physics: no face may fall below this fraction of the count it was built with, because a face whose reference area reaches zero has no tension law left. Enforced by scaling each edge's one antisymmetric flux with its donor face's allowance, so the guard cannot create or destroy material the way clipping each face after the update would. One starved face therefore does not freeze the whole sheet. A run that reaches the floor is a run whose redistribution was limited, and the minimum donor allowance is in the record; it is not a failure of the step.

record_snapshot.name: sim.inplane_flow_cg_iters

declaration.source: numerical budget, not physics: the fixed Jacobi-PCG iteration count of the backward-Euler edge solve in physics.surface_count_flow. Explicit time stepping is unusable here — at the native spacing the fastest face pair relaxes in ~5e-7 s against a step of 1e-2 s — so the solve is implicit and run to a BUDGET, never to a tolerance that would need a host read inside the step. Conservation of the total count does not depend on this number (the unknown is the per-edge flux and every edge hands its two faces the same value with opposite signs); an under-solved step redistributes LESS, never more or from nowhere. 64 is a starting budget for a system whose condition number is about 1 + dt x lambda_max. The per-step record reports aggregate count/conservation diagnostics; the full per-face count is declared dynamic provider state, but continuation still requires recorder integration and a verified restore.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: count is number of bundles; filaments is strands per bundle. Straight parallel chains are placed across a cap about +z. cos(polar angle) is distributed across the cap; cap_angle is not the angle between actin filaments. This builder alone supplies no root-to-lamellipodium mechanical bond.

n_filaments is the total chain count. Chains alternate between plus/minus mode_angle about +x; the builder explicitly has no mother-daughter junctions. Orientation modes alone therefore do not establish Arp2/3 branch topology.

filaments is strands per arc, not the number of arcs. Arc count and radii depend on pitch, lift, cell/basal geometry, lamellipodial width and strand packing. n_stations_placed is zero. Placement is not evidence of a focal-adhesion link.

Hexagonal offsets use centerline spacing. filaments is strands per bundle; number of bundles comes from footprint. sarcomere is saved in metadata and n_stations_placed=0; this builder places no periodic myosin or alpha-actinin stations from the sarcomere input.

Conditional geometry: basal half-width=clearance*sqrt(R²-z²)/sqrt(2), SF count=int(2*half/pitch)+1, filopodium root radius=R-tip_clearance-contour. Filopodial centerline tip radius is R-tip_clearance; lateral bundle offsets mean this is not identical to every filament tip distance from the membrane.

Substrate stiffness and thickness are classified declared absent in the suspended specimen, conditional on an adherent preparation. This static metadata is not a verified native substrate implementation.

declaration.source: switch, not a material value: 1 appends the channel PROTEIN POPULATION as massive nodes tied to the sheet (physics.surface_channels.massive_node_plan + physics.surface_insertion), at membrane.channel_density x built membrane area, count = floor(density*area + 0.5). The displaced lipid mass removed from the existing membrane nodes is count x membrane.channel.excluded_lipid_area x membrane.areal_density, distributed by the host face's barycentric weights; a build that would drive any node mass to zero or below is REFUSED, never clipped. The gating chemistry is NOT switched on by this row. Default 0 leaves the node table byte-identical.

source_code_anchors.interpretation: Population append is conditional on enabled input; reads preparation fractions and mass/radius/excluded-area declarations. This caller explicitly does not turn on gating chemistry. Literal enabled=0 only describes this template if used without override and reached.
Caller copies positions, material/protein masses, radii, IDs and face support; it does not copy plan[state] into these returned tables. No assertion about every external caller or actual run is made.

N=floor(density*sum(triangle areas)+0.5). Valid C/O/I probabilities drive finite categorical draws, not exact realised fractions. Faces are area-weighted and positions barycentric. Read as text only; no RNG or model executed.

Excluded lipid mass per channel=excluded_lipid_area*lipid_areal_density, removed from host-face nodes by barycentric weights; positive masses required. Protein mass uses Da-to-pg conversion, radius is copied independently. No disk-area=pi*radius^2 relation is declared.
When channel_insertion exists, normal insertion coefficient is passed to SurfaceInsertion. Reading this adapter does not verify a native active path.

Declared energy is one-half k times squared distance to the current material surface. Pure normal force on triangle interiors; edge/vertex normal-cone and nonsmooth-switch qualifications preserved. This is confinement, not a source-measured Piezo gating stiffness.
Static kernel text assigns E=.5*k*distance_squared and equal/opposite center/face forces. No runtime import or execution; no validation authority claimed.

Source module distinguishes empty C/O/I states from species-occupied open states and explicitly calls the single-occupancy pore an exploratory mechanism. Population geometry is not proof this chemistry is connected.
Exact Boltzmann constant unit conversion gives kBT in pN·um from cell.temperature. This supports only the stated scalar energy illustration, not a runtime temperature observation.

static_definition_findings.statement: population_plan draws and returns C/O/I state. append_channel_nodes copies geometry/mass/radius/face and does not retain the state array in this caller; it explicitly does not enable gating chemistry. If the frozen enabled0 template is reached without override, it returns before planning. Neither presence of fractions nor this local source observation proves a saved runtime state.
static_definition_findings.interpretation_limit: Bounded frozen caller inspection, not an exhaustive all-caller audit, dead-parameter finding or native execution test.

limits: No physics, runtime, prior, GPU or model execution/imports; host source bytes, Git metadata and scalar arithmetic only.
Six raw declarations, existing ranges and priors are unchanged. Five EXAMPLE rows and one SWEPT row retain their distinct tags.
No current fit membership, empirical pairs, covariance, native measurements, calibrated drag radius, training labels or new sampling distributions.
Closed cryo-EM structure is not a closed-state probability measurement. Geometry preparation and connected gating must be distinguished.
Dome midplane area, projected area, projected-area change, protein-lipid exclusion and surrounding membrane footprint are different quantities.
MC04 reuses MC02 structure; historical reviews are same-source records, not additional independent evidence.
Mouse structural constructs and canonical human sequence mass do not specify MCF7 isoform/glycoform/associated-lipid mass.
Empty eLife and PMC challenge payloads are not fulltext evidence; successful publisher and Europe PMC/UniProt/NIST bytes are separately pinned.
Inspected static paths are bounded, not exhaustive runtime coverage. No proposed mechanism or numerical replacement is adopted.
